title: New Beast image revealed for Avengers: Doomsday
excerpt:
A new close-up reveals Kelsey Grammer's Beast.
The character returns after his cameo in The Marvels.
body_md:
A new promotional image for Avengers: Doomsday offers a closer look at Hank McCoy, better known as Beast, ahead of the Marvel crossover's theatrical release. The image appeared in Entertainment Weekly's coverage and provides a clearer view of Kelsey Grammer's returning X-Men character than the brief appearance featured in the final trailer.

Beast appeared alongside other heroes after Cyclops delivered his familiar rallying call in the trailer. For viewers who followed the earlier X-Men films, the moment was a particularly recognizable reference to the team's history. The newly released close-up allows audiences to examine details that were difficult to appreciate in the moving footage.

Grammer previously portrayed Hank McCoy in X-Men: The Last Stand. His return to the character came in the post-credits sequence of The Marvels, which introduced him to the Marvel Cinematic Universe. In the recent promotional coverage, the actor acknowledged the positive response to that relatively short appearance.

The challenge of depicting Beast goes beyond reproducing his familiar blue fur. Hank is both a formidable mutant and a highly educated scientist, whose intelligence and thoughtful personality are central to his identity. A convincing screen design needs to accommodate the character's physical power while preserving the expressive qualities associated with his more intellectual side.

The new image retains recognizable elements of Grammer's face within the character's transformed appearance. That balance is important for a performance that relies on audiences recognizing a familiar actor beneath an extraordinary visual design. Comparisons with his earlier appearance in The Marvels will be inevitable, although a promotional still cannot establish how the effects will look throughout the completed movie.

Nicholas Hoult portrayed a younger version of Hank in the X-Men prequel films. Grammer's return alongside performers including Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, James Marsden and Rebecca Romijn brings the forthcoming crossover into closer contact with the earlier generation of cinematic X-Men.

The precise extent of Beast's involvement in the story remains unclear. His intelligence makes potential encounters with other Marvel scientists an appealing prospect, but the released image does not confirm those interactions or reveal the outcome of any confrontation.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to open on December 18, 2026. Until audiences can see the complete film, the latest promotional photograph provides one of the clearest opportunities to examine Grammer's returning version of the character and the design choices behind his appearance.
